fullPassage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we’re better off shifting to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo. You start by asking everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool them and share them anonymously among the group. To preserve independent judgment, each member evaluates them on their own. Only then does the team come together to select and refine the most promising options. By developing and assessing ideas individually before choosing and elaborating them, teams can surface and advance possibilities that might not get attention otherwise. This brainwriting process makes sure that all ideas are brought to the table and all voices are brought into the conversation. It is especially effective in groups that struggle to achieve collective intelligence.

❌ ② (A) 공유하다 — (B) 나누다(동사): (B)는 동사가 아니라 명사 '몫'
✅ ③ (A) 공유하다 — (B) 몫/지분: (A) share your ideas는 '공유하다'(동사), (B) a larger share of the profit는 '몫/지분'(명사) ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 나누다 — (B) 공유하다: (A)는 '공유하다', (B)는 '몫'
det.tip: share: ① (동사) 공유하다 ② (명사) 몫/지분 — 본문 share them은 ① 공유하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to keep something in its original state or protect it from being lost or harmed"

det.korean: preserve=지키다/보존하다 (원래 상태로 유지하거나 잃지 않게 보호하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① waste(낭비하다): 보존과 반대되는 의미
❌ ② destroy(파괴하다): 보호와 정반대
❌ ③ reveal(드러내다): 상태 유지와 무관한 의미
✅ ④ preserve: '원래 상태로 유지하거나 잃지 않게 보호하다'라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: To preserve independent judgment — 독립적 판단을 지키다(preserve)

questions.passage: You start by __________ (ask) everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool them and share them anonymously among the group.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(ask)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: start by __(ask) → 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 오므로 동사 ask를 asking으로 변형. by asking = 요청함으로써.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 전치사 by가 있어요. 전치사 뒤에는 동사를 그대로 쓸 수 없고 동명사(-ing) 형태가 와야 해요. 그래서 동사 ask를 asking으로 바꿔 'by asking(요청함으로써)'이 되어야 합니다. 정답은 asking.
det.tip: 전치사 by + 동명사(-ing): ask → asking

questions.passage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we are better off __________ (shift) to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(shift)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: be better off __(shift) → 'be better off + 동명사(-ing)'는 '~하는 것이 더 낫다'라는 표현이므로 shift를 shifting으로 변형.
det.analysis: 'be better off + -ing'는 '~하는 편이 더 낫다'라는 관용 표현이에요. 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 동사 shift를 shifting으로 바꿔야 합니다. 'we are better off shifting(전환하는 편이 낫다)'. 정답은 shifting.
det.tip: be better off + 동명사(-ing): shift → shifting

questions.passage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we’re better off shifting to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo. You start by asking everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool them and share them anonymously among the group. To preserve independent judgment, each member evaluates them __________. Only then does the team come together to select and refine the most promising options. By developing and assessing ideas individually before choosing and elaborating them, teams can surface and advance possibilities that might not get attention otherwise. This brainwriting process makes sure that all ideas are brought to the table and all voices are brought into the conversation. It is especially effective in groups that struggle to achieve collective intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 독립적 판단을 지키기 위해 각 구성원이 '스스로(on their own)' 평가한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① on their own: 원문 일치. '독립적 판단을 지키려고 각자 스스로(on their own) 평가한다'는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② with the whole group(전체 그룹과 함께): 독립적 판단을 지킨다는 맥락과 모순
❌ ③ after a long meeting(긴 회의 후에): 문맥상 근거 없음
❌ ④ by copying others(남을 베껴서): 독립적 판단과 정반대
det.tip: each member evaluates them on their own — 스스로(on their own)

questions.passage: To find the hidden potential in teams, instead of brainstorming, we’re better off shifting to a process called brainwriting. The initial steps are solo. You start by asking everyone to generate ideas separately. Next, you pool them and share them anonymously among the group. To preserve independent judgment, each member evaluates them on their own. Only then does the team come together to select and refine __________. By developing and assessing ideas individually before choosing and elaborating them, teams can surface and advance possibilities that might not get attention otherwise. This brainwriting process makes sure that all ideas are brought to the table and all voices are brought into the conversation. It is especially effective in groups that struggle to achieve collective intelligence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팀이 함께 모여 '가장 유망한 선택지(the most promising options)'를 선택하고 다듬는다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① the least useful options(가장 쓸모없는 선택지): 최선을 고른다는 흐름과 반대
✅ ② the most promising options: 원문 일치. 팀이 모여 '가장 유망한 선택지'를 선택·개선한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ their personal complaints(개인적 불평): 본문에 근거 없음
❌ ④ the fastest possible answers(가장 빠른 답): 속도가 아니라 '유망함'이 기준이므로 부적절
det.tip: select and refine the most promising options — 가장 유망한 선택지
